facts.text: Reid's Palace stands in Funchal, Madeira, above the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: From the shores of Funchal, Reid’s Palace offers a serene escape immersed in tropical gardens and the breathtaking beauty of the Atlantic Ocean.

facts.text: The hotel was opened by the Reid family in 1891.
facts.excerpt: since its opening by the Reid family in 1891

facts.text: Early guests who arrived by boat were carried up the cliff in hammocks.
facts.excerpt: guests who arrive by boat are carried up the cliff in hammocks by strapping porters

facts.text: Belmond took over the hotel in 1996.
facts.excerpt: Belmond took over in 1996

facts.text: Interiors include Portuguese tiles and vintage photographs of Winston Churchill at a typewriter.
facts.excerpt: Portuguese tiles and vintage photographs of a cigar-smoking Winston Churchill tapping away on his typewriter

facts.text: The hotel has three outdoor swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: Three outdoor swimming pools

facts.text: The hotel has direct access to the sea.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to the sea

facts.text: A saltwater pool sits at ocean level, reached by a cliff-hugging lift.
facts.excerpt: ocean-level saltwater pool (via the iconic cliff-hugging lift;

facts.text: Maré Spa offers regional treatments using aloe vera balsam and grapeseed oil.
facts.excerpt: aloe vera balsam and grapeseed oil combined with the aromas of flora from the garden and scents from the sea

facts.text: The grounds include subtropical gardens, and guests can book a garden tour.
facts.excerpt: book a garden tour to learn all about their tree and flower collection

facts.text: Ristorante Villa Cipriani serves casual dinner on its terrace.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a casual dinner on the terrace of Ristorante Villa Cipriani

facts.text: Classic afternoon tea is held on a black-and-white checkered terrace.
facts.excerpt: Classic afternoon tea is held on the black-and-white checkered terrace

facts.text: The hotel lists the William Restaurant as Michelin-starred.
facts.excerpt: Michelin-starred William Restaurant

facts.text: The hotel has a kids' club called Fun@Reid's.
facts.excerpt: Fun@Reid’s kid’s club

facts.text: The hotel offers pet-friendly amenities.
facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly amenities

facts.text: Bathrooms have tubs and showers and soaps from the Portuguese brand Claus Porto.
facts.excerpt: bathrooms are equipped with tubs and showers and delicious soaps from Portuguese brand Claus Porto

facts.text: The hotel is a 20-minute drive from Madeira International Airport.
facts.excerpt: 20-minute drive from Madeira International Airport (FNC)

facts.text: The hotel is a 10-minute drive from central Funchal.
facts.excerpt: 10-minute drive from central Funchal

facts.text: Pico do Arieiro is a 40-minute drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: 40-minute drive from Pico do Arieiro

facts.text: Afternoon tea is normally fully booked with outside guests, so guests should secure a spot in advance with the front desk.
facts.excerpt: secure a spot in advance with the front desk as it’s normally fully booked with outside guests

facts.text: There is one accessible room and a few ramps, but some elevators are too small for wheelchair access.
facts.excerpt: There is one accessible room and a few ramps throughout the hotel, but do note that some elevators are too small for wheelchair access.
